Titillation voluptuous, but painful, around corona glandis.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Ictod.]
Spasmodic asthma.
Sudden anxiety, with dyspnœa and sweat, followed by stool and relief of that and other complaints.
Asthma, aggravated or caused by dust. θ Heaves in horses from dusty hay.

Senile catarrh.
